name: agentic_promps_web_bench
description: A dataset and evaluation suite of web-oriented, agentic prompts designed to assess how models perform agentic/web-like tasks (planning, information retrieval, action sequencing, and safety-aware decision making). Evaluations combine model-generated open-ended outputs with human judgments and automated checks to measure task success, correctness, and adherence to constraints. The benchmark targets capabilities important for web agents and interactive systems.
evaluation_method: human_eval_and_automated_checks (human preference/judgment plus automated task-success verification)
reputation: Low to moderate; appears to be a community-contributed Hugging Face benchmark with limited published adoption so far.
